meta.title: Gogh Editor
meta.description: Elliot Grey, a photographer’s site built with gogh — drag anything, roll the die on a section, publish.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// blueprint.json is CDN-cached for a week wherever it's linked — so the
// living boot code is fetched fresh from the repo (raw caches ~5 minutes).
// If the fetch fails, fall back to whatever this cached copy knows.
// this blueprint: the Photographer design (Elliot Grey) with the classic header
define( 'GOGH_DEMO_STARTER', 'photographer' );
define( 'GOGH_DEMO_HEADER', 'gogh-header-classic' );
define( 'GOGH_DEMO_TITLE', 'Elliot Grey' );
define( 'GOGH_DEMO_MEDIA', array( 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516483638261-f4dbaf036963?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=80', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544005313-94ddf0286df2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523217582562-09d0def993a6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507525428034-b723cf961d3e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506794778202-cad84cf45f1d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80', 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518005020951-eccb494ad742?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80' ) );
$boot = false;
try {
	$boot = file_get_contents( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jamiemarsland/gogh-demo/main/demo-boot.php' );
} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
if ( $boot && false !== strpos( $boot, 'gogh' ) ) {
	eval( '?>' . $boot );
	return;
}
// fallback: minimal boot — apply the design with the installed plugin
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try {
	$req = new WP_REST_Request( 'POST', '/gogh/v1/starter' );
	$req->set_param( 'slug', 'photographer' );
	rest_do_request( $req );
} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
